title: Luna the Cat and the Missing Ball

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Who has soft fur, pointy ears, and long whiskers?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Who says: meow, meow? Can you guess?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: It's... a cat!

vo.speaker: luna
vo.text: Meow! Hello! I'm Luna the kitten!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Hi, Luna! I'm Super Bobo! What's that?

vo.speaker: luna
vo.text: It's my red ball! It has a little bell inside. Jingle, jingle!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What does a cat say?

vo.speaker: luna
vo.text: Meow! Meow!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Can you meow like Luna? Your turn!

vo.speaker: luna
vo.text: Meow! Meow!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: And when a cat is happy and cozy, it purrs! Purrrr...

vo.speaker: luna
vo.text: Purrrr... Your turn! Purrrr!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Let's learn three cat facts!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Fact one. Cats have super ears! They can hear tiny, tiny sounds, and turn their ears to listen.

vo.speaker: luna
vo.text: My ears go this way, and that way! I can hear a little mouse!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Fact two. A cat uses its whiskers to feel things around it, even in the dark!

vo.speaker: luna
vo.text: Boing, boing! My whiskers help me!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Fact three. Cats sleep a lot! Many cats sleep for more than half of the day.

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: More than half the day? Wow! Sleepy kitties!

vo.speaker: luna
vo.text: Cats love to play! Watch me! I can stretch!

vo.speaker: luna
vo.text: I can pounce!

vo.speaker: luna
vo.text: And I can chase my tail! Round and round!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Can you stretch like Luna? Your turn! Stretch up high!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Luna and Bobo played catch with the red ball. Bounce, bounce!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Here it comes! Oops! Too hard!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: The ball rolled away... far, far away, into the forest. Luna felt sad.

vo.speaker: luna
vo.text: My ball! Where did it go?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: How can Luna find her ball? Remember, it has a bell inside!

vo.speaker: luna
vo.text: I know! I will use my super ears! Listen...

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Jingle, jingle! Luna tiptoed past the flowers...

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Tiptoe with Luna! Shhh... tiptoe, tiptoe!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Past the little pond...

vo.speaker: luna
vo.text: A sound! Is it my ball? Oh... it was just a frog. Ribbit! Back to listening!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Jingle, jingle! The sound got louder... and louder... all the way to a big hollow log!

vo.speaker: luna
vo.text: Hello? Is my ball in there?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: And there was Max the puppy, holding the red ball!

vo.speaker: max
vo.text: Woof! Hi, Luna! Is this your ball? It rolled right to me. I kept it safe for you!

vo.speaker: luna
vo.text: My ball! Thank you, Max! You are so kind!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Max gave the ball back to Luna. Luna gave Max a happy purr.

vo.speaker: luna
vo.text: Max, do you want to play catch with us? Together is more fun!

vo.speaker: max
vo.text: Yes, please! Woof, woof!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: When we find something that belongs to a friend, we give it back. And playing together is more fun!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: And remember, friends: always ask a grown-up before you go and look for a lost toy!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: So Luna, Max, and Bobo played catch all afternoon. Bounce, bounce, catch!

vo.speaker: luna
vo.text: Yawn... now it is time for a cat nap. Purrrr...

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Let's remember!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What does a cat say?

vo.speaker: luna
vo.text: Meow! Meow!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What does it mean when a cat purrs?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: The cat is happy and cozy!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: How did Luna find her ball?

vo.speaker: luna
vo.text: With my super ears! I listened for the jingle!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Who kept the ball safe?

vo.speaker: max
vo.text: Me! Max the puppy! Woof!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: What do cats use to feel things in the dark?

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Their whiskers!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Say it with Luna!

vo.speaker: luna
vo.text: Listen, listen!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Jingle, jingle!

vo.speaker: luna
vo.text: Luna finds the ball!

vo.speaker: narrator
vo.text: Your turn! Listen, listen! Jingle, jingle! Luna finds the ball!

vo.speaker: luna
vo.text: Bye-bye, friends! Meow!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: See you next time!
